known_patches: Integer identity schemas and synthetic source persona
Original source semantics bounded by actual probes
limitations: Only Schedule name/timeZone metadata CRUD certified; source schedule/days/startTime/endTime inputs do not create availability blocks in these executors. No booking, email/SMS, external calendar, webhooks, payment or video effect executed.
Source Schedule update checks target owner. Schedule delete only counts caller-owned schedules >=2 and does not bind target owner: deletion of another account schedule succeeds and is probed.
Source eventtype_list scopes owner, but eventtype_get crud.fetch ignores declared owner scope and another signed-in user reads known id. User roles and team membership remain unchanged.
String business UUIDs and unused text primary keys remain source values; no unclaimed entity/tool modernization.
